import MumfordLib.SingularAffineSimplexGeometry

/-!
# Quantitative barycenter bounds for subdivision

For a list of `r` vertices with pairwise distances at most `D`, the barycenter
is within `(r - 1) / r * D` of each vertex and hence of their entire convex hull.
This is the contraction estimate for coning subdivided faces.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Nonempty I]

/-- The barycenter-to-vertex distance has the strict mesh contraction factor. -/
theorem affineSimplexBarycenter_dist_le_card_ratio
    (v : I → stdSimplex ℝ J) {D : ℝ}
    (hD : ∀ i j, dist (v i) (v j) ≤ D) (i : I) :
    dist (affineSimplexBarycenter v) (v i) ≤
      ((Fintype.card I - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card I * D := by
  classical
  have hcard : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card I := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hdiff : (affineSimplexBarycenter v).val - (v i).val =
      (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ j, ((v j).val - (v i).val) := by
    ext j
    change (affineSimplexBarycenter v).val j - (v i).val j =
      (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∑ a, ((v a).val - (v i).val)) j
    rw [Finset.sum_apply]
    change affineSimplexBarycenter v j - v i j =
      (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ a, (v a j - v i j)
    rw [affineSimplexBarycenter_apply, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  have hsum : (∑ j, ‖(v j).val - (v i).val‖) ≤
      ((Fintype.card I - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * D := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ‖(v j).val - (v i).val‖ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_erase_eq_sub (Finset.mem_univ i)]
        simp
      _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, D := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j _
        exact hD j i
      _ = _ := by simp
  calc
    dist (affineSimplexBarycenter v) (v i) =
        (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖∑ j, ((v j).val - (v i).val)‖ := by
      rw [Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, hdiff, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hcard)]
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∑ j, ‖(v j).val - (v i).val‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_sum_le _ _) (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hcard))
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ)⁻¹ * (((Fintype.card I - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * D) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hcard))
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- The barycenter contraction estimate holds throughout the affine image. -/
theorem affineSimplexBarycenter_dist_affineSimplexMap_le_card_ratio
    (v : I → stdSimplex ℝ J) {D : ℝ}
    (hD : ∀ i j, dist (v i) (v j) ≤ D) (t : stdSimplex ℝ I) :
    dist (affineSimplexBarycenter v) (affineSimplexMap v t) ≤
      ((Fintype.card I - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card I * D := by
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, h⟩ :=
    convexHull_exists_dist_ge (affineSimplexMap_mem_convexHull v t)
      (affineSimplexBarycenter v).val
  have hi : dist (v i).val (affineSimplexBarycenter v).val ≤
      ((Fintype.card I - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card I * D := by
    simpa only [Subtype.dist_eq, dist_comm] using
      affineSimplexBarycenter_dist_le_card_ratio v hD i
  simpa only [Subtype.dist_eq, dist_comm] using h.trans hi

end Mumford.Analytic
